Product Description

HMT Gandaberunda JGSL 01 – White Dial Leather Strap Watch for Men

Blending heritage style with modern detailing, the HMT Gandaberunda JGSL 01 is an analog timepiece , crafted for those who appreciate understated elegance. It features a unique White dial housed in a sleek steel-colored brass case, giving it a distinct and refined appeal. The watch runs on a reliable quartz movement and is paired with a comfortable brown leather strap secured by a buckle lock. With its slim 7.1 mm profile and 3 ATM water resistance, this watch offers everyday ease with a timeless edge.
